Script.name: igoto.core
Script.script:
-- Icesus Goto + Room Nicknames ------------------------------------------- -- A small add-on that sits on top of the official Icesus package's mapper. -- It never touches Icesus's own files: it reads the map data Icesus keeps -- (icesus.mapper.idMap.idToRoom, the hexId -> Mudlet-room table), drives -- Mudlet's built-in pathfinder, and stores its own nicknames in a separate -- file, so the Icesus package auto-update can never clobber it. -- -- Commands (aliases): -- goto <dest> / gt <dest> travel to a nickname, room number, or name -- goto stop / gt stop abort the current walk -- goto reweigh / gt reweigh (re)weight the whole map from terrain -- goto help / gt help show help -- rnick <name> / rn <name> save the current room under <name> -- rnick list / rn list list saved nicknames -- rnick del <name> delete a nickname -- rnick go <name> same as goto <name> -------------------------------------------------------------------------
igoto = igoto or {} igoto.nicks = igoto.nicks or {} igoto.links = igoto.links or {} igoto.walk = igoto.walk or { active = false } if igoto.adjacent == nil then igoto.adjacent = true end -- place new rooms adjacent if igoto.annotate == nil then igoto.annotate = true end -- show hidden exits in room line if igoto.reroute == nil then igoto.reroute = true end -- typing the map-dir sends the phrase
-- ---- tunables ---------------------------------------------------------- igoto.MAX_STEPS = 500 -- hard cap on commands sent in one goto igoto.STEP_TIMEOUT = 2.5 -- s to wait for a Room.Info after a single step igoto.ROAD_SAFETY = 2.0 -- s fallback if the "stop walking" line never comes igoto.STALL_LIMIT = 25 -- give up if this many moves bring us no closer
-- Cost-to-leave a room by terrain, seeded onto Mudlet room weights so the -- pathfinder prefers roads and cheap ground instead of shortest hop count. -- Values follow the movement-cost notes: road/crossing 1, path 2, open -- ground 6, rising to mountain 14. igoto.WEIGHTS = { road = 1, crossing = 1, path = 2, plains = 6, forest = 6, swamp = 8, badlands = 8, ashlands = 8, water = 10, ice = 10, mountain = 14, }
-- Env-id -> weight, mirroring the Icesus package's TERRAIN_ENV constants, -- used to weight rooms already on the map (which no longer carry a live -- terrain string) from the colour Icesus painted them. igoto.ENV_WEIGHT = { [200] = 1, -- road [201] = 2, -- path [202] = 10, -- water [203] = 8, -- swamp [204] = 14, -- mountain [205] = 6, -- plains [206] = 6, -- forest [207] = 10, -- ice [209] = 8, -- badlands [210] = 8, -- ashlands -- 208 is Icesus's transparent cursor room -- never weight it. }
-- Standard directions accept short or long forms; normalise to the long -- forms Icesus's exits use. Anything not here (special exits like -- "enter shop") is sent verbatim. igoto.DIR = { n = "north", s = "south", e = "east", w = "west", ne = "northeast", nw = "northwest", se = "southeast", sw = "southwest", u = "up", d = "down", ["in"] = "in", out = "out", north = "north", south = "south", east = "east", west = "west", northeast = "northeast", northwest = "northwest", southeast = "southeast", southwest = "southwest", up = "up", down = "down", }
-- Capitalised abbreviations trigger Icesus's server-side road-walk, which -- follows the road across many rooms and stops on its own. Only the eight -- compass directions road-walk; up/down/in/out/specials always single-step. local CAP = { north = "N", south = "S", east = "E", west = "W", northeast = "NE", northwest = "NW", southeast = "SE", southwest = "SW", }
-- Opposite directions — for the road-walk overshoot guard and for working out -- which way we moved into a new room (from the exit that leads back). local OPP = { north = "south", south = "north", east = "west", west = "east", northeast = "southwest", southwest = "northeast", northwest = "southeast", southeast = "northwest", up = "down", down = "up", }
-- Special-exit command colour the game uses (the bright green of "leave"). igoto.LINK_CMD_COLOR = { 0, 255, 0 } -- Colour of the dotted map line drawn for a cardinal hidden exit. igoto.LINK_LINE_COLOR = { 0, 200, 0 }
-- Map-cell offsets (Mudlet coords: +y = north), for placing the far room of a -- hidden exit when a direction is given. Keyed by long form. igoto.OFFSET = { north = { 0, 1, 0 }, south = { 0, -1, 0 }, east = { 1, 0, 0 }, west = {-1, 0, 0 }, northeast = { 1, 1, 0 }, northwest = {-1, 1, 0 }, southeast = { 1, -1, 0 }, southwest = {-1, -1, 0 }, up = { 0, 0, 1 }, down = { 0, 0, -1 }, }
-- ---- small helpers ----------------------------------------------------- local function trim(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end
local function say(fmt, ...) cecho("<sea_green>goto:<reset> " .. string.format(fmt, ...) .. "\n") end local function warn(fmt, ...) cecho("<indian_red>goto:<reset> " .. string.format(fmt, ...) .. "\n") end
local function copyArr(t) local out = {} if type(t) == "table" then for i = 1, #t do out[i] = t[i] end end return out end
local function idMap() return icesus and icesus.mapper and icesus.mapper.idMap end
-- Current room's hex id, read straight from the live GMCP payload so it -- does not depend on which Room.Info handler ran first; falls back to the -- pointer Icesus maintains. local function curHex() local r = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if r and type(r.id) == "string" and r.id ~= "" then return r.id end return icesus and icesus.mapper and icesus.mapper.lastHexId end
local function roomOfHex(hex) local m = idMap() if not (m and m.idToRoom and hex) then return nil end local id = m.idToRoom[hex] if id and (not roomExists or roomExists(id)) then return id end return nil end
-- Returns Mudlet room id, hex id of where the player is now. function igoto.currentRoom() local hex = curHex() if not hex then return nil, nil end return roomOfHex(hex), hex end
local function roomLabel(id) local nm = (getRoomName and id) and getRoomName(id) or nil if nm and nm ~= "" then return string.format("%s (#%d)", nm, id) end return "room #" .. tostring(id) end
-- Compact "#id (x,y,z) area N" for diagnostics. local function roomPos(id) if not id then return "nil" end local xs = "?" if getRoomCoordinates then local ok, x, y, z = pcall(getRoomCoordinates, id) if ok and x then xs = string.format("(%s,%s,%s)", x, y, z) end end local a = "?" if getRoomArea then local okA, aid = pcall(getRoomArea, id) if okA then a = tostring(aid) end end return string.format("#%s %s area %s", tostring(id), xs, a) end
-- ---- terrain weighting ------------------------------------------------- -- Seed the current room's weight from its live terrain, every step. -- Skip rooms flagged as dangerous so reweigh can't silently disarm the flag. function igoto.seedWeight() if not setRoomWeight then return end local r = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if not r then return end local hex = curHex() if hex and igoto.danger[hex] then return end -- preserve danger weight local w = igoto.WEIGHTS[r.terrain] if not w then return end local id = igoto.currentRoom() if id then pcall(setRoomWeight, id, w) end end
-- One-shot: weight every room already on the map from its stored env -- colour. Run it once after installing so goto routes well immediately, -- without having to re-walk the whole world. -- Skips dangerous rooms and re-stamps their high weight at the end. function igoto.reweighAll() if not setRoomWeight then warn("this Mudlet build has no setRoomWeight.") return end local m = idMap() if not (m and m.idToRoom) then warn("map not loaded yet -- walk a step, then try again.") return end local seen, weighted = 0, 0 for hex, id in pairs(m.idToRoom) do if (not roomExists) or roomExists(id) then seen = seen + 1 if not igoto.danger[hex] then local env = getRoomEnv and getRoomEnv(id) local w = env and igoto.ENV_WEIGHT[env] if w then pcall(setRoomWeight, id, w); weighted = weighted + 1 end end end end igoto.applyDanger() -- re-stamp high weights on danger rooms say("weighted %d of %d rooms from terrain.", weighted, seen) end
-- ---- dangerous room flagging ------------------------------------------- -- A flagged room gets weight DANGER_WEIGHT; the pathfinder strongly prefers -- any other route but will still use this room if it's the only way through. local DANGER_WEIGHT = 500 local function dangerPath() return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/IcesusGoto.danger.lua" end
igoto.danger = igoto.danger or {} -- hex -> true
function igoto.saveDanger() if table and table.save then pcall(table.save, dangerPath(), igoto.danger) end end
function igoto.loadDanger() local p = dangerPath() if io and io.exists and io.exists(p) and table and table.load then local t = {}; local ok = pcall(table.load, p, t) if ok and type(t) == "table" then igoto.danger = t end end end
-- Stamp the high weight onto every flagged room (called at boot + after reweigh). function igoto.applyDanger() if not setRoomWeight then return end local m = idMap() if not (m and m.idToRoom) then return end for hex, _ in pairs(igoto.danger) do local id = m.idToRoom[hex] if id and ((not roomExists) or roomExists(id)) then pcall(setRoomWeight, id, DANGER_WEIGHT) end end end
function igoto.dangerMark() local hex = curHex() local id = hex and igoto.currentRoom() if not hex or not id then warn("I don't know where you are yet.") return end igoto.danger[hex] = true if setRoomWeight then pcall(setRoomWeight, id, DANGER_WEIGHT) end igoto.saveDanger() say("room %s flagged as dangerous (weight %d). goto will avoid it.", roomLabel(id), DANGER_WEIGHT) end
function igoto.dangerUnmark() local hex = curHex() local id = hex and igoto.currentRoom() if not hex or not id then warn("I don't know where you are yet.") return end if not igoto.danger[hex] then say("this room isn't flagged.") return end igoto.danger[hex] = nil -- Restore terrain weight from env colour (best-effort). if setRoomWeight and getRoomEnv then local env = getRoomEnv(id) local w = env and igoto.ENV_WEIGHT[env] pcall(setRoomWeight, id, w or 5) end igoto.saveDanger() say("room %s unmarked -- weight restored to terrain.", roomLabel(id)) end
function igoto.dangerList() local m = idMap() local rows = {} for hex, _ in pairs(igoto.danger) do local id = m and m.idToRoom and m.idToRoom[hex] local name = id and getRoomName and getRoomName(id) or "?" rows[#rows + 1] = string.format(" <indian_red>%s<reset> #%s %s\n", hex, tostring(id or "?"), name) end if #rows == 0 then say("no rooms flagged as dangerous.") return end cecho(string.format("<sea_green>goto:<reset> %d dangerous room(s):\n", #rows)) table.sort(rows) for _, line in ipairs(rows) do cecho(line) end end
-- ---- destination resolution ------------------------------------------- -- Returns roomId, errMessage, label. Order: nickname, room number, name. function igoto.resolve(arg) arg = trim(arg) if arg == "" then return nil, "no destination given" end
local nk = igoto.nicks[arg:lower()] if nk then local id = roomOfHex(nk.hex) if id then return id, nil, string.format("'%s'", nk.name or arg) end return nil, string.format("nickname '%s' points at a room that isn't on the map yet", nk.name or arg) end
local n = tonumber(arg) if n and roomExists and roomExists(n) then return n, nil, roomLabel(n) end
if searchRoom then local ok, res = pcall(searchRoom, arg) -- substring, case-insensitive if ok and type(res) == "table" then local ids = {} for id in pairs(res) do ids[#ids + 1] = id end if #ids == 1 then return ids[1], nil, roomLabel(ids[1]) elseif #ids > 1 then table.sort(ids) warn("'%s' matches %d rooms -- pick one by number:", arg, #ids) for i = 1, math.min(#ids, 12) do cecho(string.format(" <cyan>%d<reset> %s\n", ids[i], res[ids[i]] or "")) end if #ids > 12 then cecho(" ... and " .. (#ids - 12) .. " more.\n") end return nil, nil, nil, true -- handled: already reported end end end
return nil, string.format("no nickname, room number, or room name matched '%s'", arg) end
-- ---- the walker -------------------------------------------------------- -- Recompute-per-stop. After every completed move we ask getPath again from -- the room we ACTUALLY landed in and take its first direction. There is no -- predicted room to match, so a walk can never be falsely declared "lost" -- -- it stops only on arrival, when getPath finds no route, or when a step is -- physically blocked. -- -- Road-walking: when on a road/path we send the capitalised direction and let -- the server walk the road until it halts on its own. Completion is read from -- the game's own lines (fast), not a timer: "You stop walking ...wards to ..." -- ends a segment, and "different terrain ... you stand still" means the capital -- was refused, so we cross with one lowercase step. A safety timer only fires -- if neither line arrives.
local function clearTimers() local w = igoto.walk if not w then return end if w.timeout then killTimer(w.timeout); w.timeout = nil end end
function igoto.stop(silent) clearTimers() local w = igoto.walk if w and w.active then w.active = false if not silent then cecho("<orange>goto:<reset> stopped.\n") end end end
local function finish() local w = igoto.walk clearTimers() w.active = false say("arrived at %s (%d moves).", w.label, w.moves or 0) end
-- Road-walk (capitalised directions) works only in the Outworld. Outworld -- tiles are the ones the server gives grid coordinates to -- the same test -- the Icesus mapper itself uses to decide a tile is outworld. local function inOutworld() local r = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if type(r) ~= "table" then return false end if type(r.coords) == "table" and #r.coords >= 2 then return true end if tonumber(r.x) and tonumber(r.y) then return true end -- hedge on field shape return false end
-- Current room's name, from the live payload or the stored map. local function roomName() local r = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if r and type(r.name) == "string" and r.name ~= "" then return r.name end local id = igoto.currentRoom() if id and getRoomName then return getRoomName(id) end return nil end
-- Are we standing on a road/path? The server only road-walks (many rooms) -- from a road or path; off-road a capital direction just steps one room, and -- crossing a terrain boundary it refuses ("you stand still"). Roads/paths -- exist only in the Outworld, so this doubles as the "can road-walk" test. -- Most reliable signal is the room NAME ("On an east-west road", "A frozen -- path", "A crossing"); backed by the env colour Icesus paints (road=200, -- path=201) and the terrain string. local function onRoad() local name = roomName() if type(name) == "string" then local n = name:lower() if n:find("road") or n:find("path") or n:find("crossing") or n:find("street") or n:find("bridge") or n:find("trail") then return true end end local id = igoto.currentRoom() if id and getRoomEnv then local e = getRoomEnv(id) if e == 200 or e == 201 then return true end end local r = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info local t = r and r.terrain return t == "road" or t == "path" or t == "crossing" end
-- Decide and send the next command from wherever we are now. local function advance(retry) local w = igoto.walk if not (w and w.active) then return end local here = igoto.currentRoom() if not here then if not retry then tempTimer(0, function() advance(true) end) end return end if here == w.target then finish() return end if not (getPath and getPath(here, w.target)) then warn("no route from %s -- stopping.", roomLabel(here)) igoto.stop(true) return end local dirs = copyArr(speedWalkDir) if #dirs == 0 then finish() return end
-- Progress guard: remaining steps should trend downward. local rem = #dirs if rem < (w.best or math.huge) then w.best = rem; w.stall = 0 else w.stall = (w.stall or 0) + 1 end if (w.stall or 0) > igoto.STALL_LIMIT then warn("not getting closer (stuck near %s) -- stopping.", roomLabel(here)) igoto.stop(true) return end if (w.moves or 0) >= igoto.MAX_STEPS then warn("move limit (%d) reached -- stopping.", igoto.MAX_STEPS) igoto.stop(true) return end
-- Normalise the pathfinder's direction to its long form BEFORE any lookup: -- getPath may hand back "e"/"sw" or "east"/"southwest"; a special exit (e.g. -- "enter shop") isn't in the table and passes through verbatim. local raw = dirs[1] local d = igoto.DIR[raw] or raw -- Overshot a turn on the last road-walk? Approach the next one on foot. if w.lastMode == "road" and OPP[d] and OPP[d] == w.lastDir then w.forceStep = 3 end -- Road-walk needs BOTH: in the Outworld AND on a road/path. The Outworld -- guard matters because an indoor room named like a road/street would pass -- onRoad() on its own. local road = onRoad() local ow = inOutworld() local canRoad = CAP[d] and ow and road and (not w.forceStep or w.forceStep <= 0)
if igoto.trace then cecho(string.format("<grey>[goto] raw=%s canon=%s outworld=%s onRoad=%s -> %s<reset>\n", tostring(raw), tostring(d), tostring(ow), tostring(road), canRoad and ("road " .. CAP[d]) or "step")) end
w.moves = (w.moves or 0) + 1 w.lastDir = d w.awaiting = true clearTimers() if canRoad then w.mode, w.lastMode = "road", "road" w.roadFrom = here -- detect zero-progress stops (road leads to boundary) -- Completion is driven by the "You stop walking ..." trigger (fast) and -- refusal by the "you stand still" trigger; this timer is only a safety -- net for when neither line arrives. w.timeout = tempTimer(igoto.ROAD_SAFETY, function() igoto.roadSafety() end) send(CAP[d]) else w.mode, w.lastMode = "step", "step" if w.forceStep and w.forceStep > 0 then w.forceStep = w.forceStep - 1 end w.timeout = tempTimer(igoto.STEP_TIMEOUT, function() igoto.onStepTimeout() end) send(d) end end
function igoto.start(targetId, label) igoto.stop(true) local from = igoto.currentRoom() if not from then warn("I don't know where you are yet -- take one step so the mapper sees the room.") return end if from == targetId then say("you're already there.") return end if not (getPath and getPath(from, targetId)) then warn("no path found to %s.", label or ("#" .. tostring(targetId))) return end igoto.walk = { active = true, target = targetId, label = label or ("#" .. tostring(targetId)), moves = 0, best = math.huge, stall = 0, } say("routing to %s (%d steps).", igoto.walk.label, #speedWalkDir) advance() end
-- Consume the current segment and send the next command. Guarded so each -- segment advances exactly once. local function step() local w = igoto.walk if not (w and w.active) then return end w.awaiting = false clearTimers() advance() end
-- Trigger: "You stop walking <dir>wards to ..." — a road-walk segment ended. -- Advance on the next event-loop tick, by when the final room's GMCP has been -- applied, so we recompute from the true stopping room (no guessing). function igoto.onStopWalk() local w = igoto.walk if not (w and w.active and w.mode == "road" and w.awaiting) then return end w.awaiting = false clearTimers() tempTimer(0, function() local w = igoto.walk if not (w and w.active) then return end -- "The road leads to <non-Outworld entrance>" stops a road-walk without -- actually moving the player. Detect zero progress: if we're still in the -- same room we road-walked FROM, fall back to a single lowercase step so -- we cross the boundary rather than re-firing the walk forever. local here = igoto.currentRoom() if here and w.roadFrom and here == w.roadFrom then if igoto.trace then cecho("<grey>[goto] road-walk stopped without movement -- forcing single step<reset>\n") end w.mode, w.lastMode = "step", "step" w.awaiting = true w.timeout = tempTimer(igoto.STEP_TIMEOUT, function() igoto.onStepTimeout() end) send(w.lastDir) return end advance() end) end
-- Trigger: "As there is different terrain ... you stand still." — the capital -- move was refused (the road doesn't run that way). A lowercase step in the -- same direction crosses the boundary, so take exactly one. function igoto.onRefused() local w = igoto.walk if not (w and w.active and w.mode == "road" and w.awaiting) then return end w.awaiting = false clearTimers() tempTimer(0, function() local w = igoto.walk if not (w and w.active) then return end w.mode, w.lastMode = "step", "step" w.awaiting = true w.timeout = tempTimer(igoto.STEP_TIMEOUT, function() igoto.onStepTimeout() end) send(w.lastDir) end) end
-- Safety net: neither road-walk line arrived within ROAD_SAFETY. Recompute -- from wherever we actually are. function igoto.roadSafety() local w = igoto.walk if not (w and w.active and w.mode == "road" and w.awaiting) then return end step() end
-- A single step produced no Room.Info -> physically blocked (door/mob/EP). function igoto.onStepTimeout() local w = igoto.walk if not (w and w.active and w.awaiting and w.mode == "step") then return end local d = w.lastDir w.active = false clearTimers() warn("stuck going %s (no movement). Clear it, then re-run goto.", d) end
-- GMCP hook: seed the weight; in step mode a Room.Info completes the step. -- Road-mode completion is driven by the stop-walk trigger, not this. Deferred -- with tempTimer(0) so Icesus's own Room.Info handler ran first. function igoto.onRoomEvent() tempTimer(0, function() igoto.seedWeight() igoto.reapplyLinksHere() -- restore any hidden exits the mapper pruned igoto.placeAdjacent() -- drop a newly-discovered indoor room next door igoto.capturePending() -- complete a hlink recording, if one is armed igoto._prevHex = curHex() -- remember where we are for the next move local w = igoto.walk if not (w and w.active and w.awaiting) then return end if w.mode == "step" then step() end end) end
-- ---- nicknames --------------------------------------------------------- local function nicksPath() return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/IcesusGoto.nicks.lua" end
function igoto.saveNicks() if table and table.save then pcall(table.save, nicksPath(), igoto.nicks) end end
function igoto.loadNicks() local p = nicksPath() if io and io.exists and io.exists(p) and table and table.load then local t = {} local ok = pcall(table.load, p, t) if ok and type(t) == "table" then igoto.nicks = t end end end
function igoto.nickAdd(name) name = trim(name) if name == "" then warn("usage: rnick <name>") return end local id, hex = igoto.currentRoom() if not hex then warn("I don't know where you are yet -- take one step first.") return end local rname = (id and getRoomName) and getRoomName(id) or "" igoto.nicks[name:lower()] = { name = name, hex = hex, rname = rname } igoto.saveNicks() say("saved '%s' -> %s", name, (rname ~= "" and rname) or hex) end
function igoto.nickDel(name) name = trim(name) local k = name:lower() if igoto.nicks[k] then igoto.nicks[k] = nil igoto.saveNicks() say("deleted nickname '%s'.", name) else warn("no nickname '%s'.", name) end end
function igoto.nickList() local keys = {} for k in pairs(igoto.nicks) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end if #keys == 0 then say("no nicknames saved yet -- stand in a room and 'rnick <name>'.") return end table.sort(keys) cecho("<sea_green>goto:<reset> saved nicknames:\n") for _, k in ipairs(keys) do local v = igoto.nicks[k] local on = roomOfHex(v.hex) and "" or " <indian_red>(not on map)<reset>" cecho(string.format(" <cyan>%-16s<reset> %s%s\n", v.name or k, v.rname ~= "" and v.rname or v.hex, on)) end end
-- ---- hidden exits ------------------------------------------------------ -- A "hidden exit" is a command (e.g. "push statue", "climb vines") that moves -- you between two rooms with no compass direction. In Mudlet that's a SPECIAL -- EXIT. The Icesus mapper prunes special exits it doesn't see in Room.Info, -- and a hidden exit never appears there -- so we keep our own record and -- re-apply it after every visit, and getPath/goto then route through it. local function linksPath() return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/IcesusGoto.links.lua" end
function igoto.saveLinks() if table and table.save then pcall(table.save, linksPath(), igoto.links) end end
function igoto.loadLinks() local p = linksPath() if io and io.exists and io.exists(p) and table and table.load then local t = {} local ok = pcall(table.load, p, t) if ok and type(t) == "table" then igoto.links = t end end end
-- Create (and unlock) a special exit. Mudlet's function is addSpecialExit; -- setSpecialExit does NOT exist (confirmed on 4.22.0). Fall back just in case. local function makeSpecialExit(from, to, cmd) local fn = addSpecialExit or setSpecialExit if not fn then return false end local ok = pcall(fn, from, to, cmd) if ok and lockSpecialExit then pcall(lockSpecialExit, from, to, cmd, false) end return ok end local function haveSpecialExitApi() return (addSpecialExit or setSpecialExit) ~= nil end
-- Draw the map marker for a hidden exit that has a map-direction: -- up/down -> an exit stub, so Mudlet paints the up/down symbol on the room. -- cardinal -> a dotted custom line to the destination room (NO stub). local function applyLinkVisual(srcRoom, destRoom, dir) if not dir then return end if dir == "up" or dir == "down" then if setExitStub then pcall(setExitStub, srcRoom, dir, true) end elseif igoto.OFFSET[dir] then -- Cardinals: dotted line only, no exit stub (stub would imply a real mapped exit). if addCustomLine and destRoom then if removeCustomLine then pcall(removeCustomLine, srcRoom, dir) end pcall(addCustomLine, srcRoom, destRoom, dir, "dot line", igoto.LINK_LINE_COLOR) end end end
-- Push all recorded links into the live map (best-effort; used at boot). function igoto.applyLinks() if not haveSpecialExitApi() then return end for srcHex, list in pairs(igoto.links) do local srcRoom = roomOfHex(srcHex) if srcRoom then for _, lk in ipairs(list) do local d = roomOfHex(lk.destHex) if d then makeSpecialExit(srcRoom, d, lk.cmd) applyLinkVisual(srcRoom, d, lk.dir) end end end end end
-- Re-add any of THIS room's hidden exits the mapper just pruned. Runs on every -- Room.Info (after the mapper), so a link is missing for at most a few ms. function igoto.reapplyLinksHere() if not haveSpecialExitApi() then return end local cur = curHex() local list = cur and igoto.links[cur] if not list then return end local srcRoom = roomOfHex(cur) if not srcRoom then return end -- getSpecialExits is { roomid = { command = lockStatus } } on modern Mudlet, -- or a flat { command = roomid } on old builds. Collect command names from both. local have = {} if getSpecialExits then local ok, ex = pcall(getSpecialExits, srcRoom) if ok and type(ex) == "table" then for k, v in pairs(ex) do if type(v) == "table" then for cmd in pairs(v) do have[cmd] = true end else have[k] = true end end end end for _, lk in ipairs(list) do if not have[lk.cmd] then local d = roomOfHex(lk.destHex) if d and makeSpecialExit(srcRoom, d, lk.cmd) then applyLinkVisual(srcRoom, d, lk.dir) if icesus and icesus.mapper and icesus.mapper.noteDirty then icesus.mapper.noteDirty() end end end end end
-- Arm a recording: remember where we are, then send the phrase and wait for -- the room we land in. function igoto.startLink(phrase, dir) phrase = trim(phrase) if phrase == "" then warn("usage: hlink [<mapdir>] <phrase>") return end if igoto.walk and igoto.walk.active then warn("finish the current goto (or 'goto stop') before recording a link.") return end local srcRoom, srcHex = igoto.currentRoom() if not srcHex then warn("I don't know where you are yet -- take one step first.") return end if not srcRoom then warn("this room isn't mapped yet -- take a step so the mapper records it.") return end if igoto._pendingLink and igoto._pendingLink.timer then killTimer(igoto._pendingLink.timer) end igoto._pendingLink = { srcHex = srcHex, srcRoom = srcRoom, phrase = phrase, dir = dir, sname = (getRoomName and getRoomName(srcRoom)) or "", } igoto._pendingLink.timer = tempTimer(8, function() igoto.cancelLink(true) end) say("recording hidden exit '%s' from %s%s -- sending it now...", phrase, igoto._pendingLink.sname ~= "" and igoto._pendingLink.sname or ("#" .. srcRoom), dir and (" (will place the far room " .. dir .. ")") or "") send(phrase) end
function igoto.cancelLink(timedout) local p = igoto._pendingLink if not p then return end if p.timer then killTimer(p.timer) end igoto._pendingLink = nil if timedout then warn("link '%s' not recorded -- no movement seen (did the command work?).", p.phrase) end end
-- Called on each Room.Info: if a recording is armed and we've moved, wire the -- special exit source -> here and remember it. function igoto.capturePending() local p = igoto._pendingLink if not p then return end local destHex = curHex() if not destHex or destHex == p.srcHex then return end -- not moved yet igoto._pendingLink = nil if p.timer then killTimer(p.timer) end local srcRoom = roomOfHex(p.srcHex) local destRoom = roomOfHex(destHex) if not (srcRoom and destRoom) then warn("link '%s': couldn't resolve both rooms on the map.", p.phrase) return end makeSpecialExit(srcRoom, destRoom, p.phrase) applyLinkVisual(srcRoom, destRoom, p.dir)
igoto.links[p.srcHex] = igoto.links[p.srcHex] or {} local list = igoto.links[p.srcHex] for i = #list, 1, -1 do if list[i].cmd == p.phrase then table.remove(list, i) end end list[#list + 1] = { cmd = p.phrase, destHex = destHex, dir = p.dir, sname = p.sname, dname = (getRoomName and getRoomName(destRoom)) or "", } igoto.saveLinks()
-- Optional map placement: only for up/down (cardinals use a dotted line but -- don't force coordinates — the mapper owns x/y layout). if p.dir and (p.dir == "up" or p.dir == "down") and getRoomCoordinates and setRoomCoordinates then -- Area guard: don't yank the dest room into a different area's coordinate -- space. Skip placement if they're in different (known) areas. local sameArea = true if getRoomArea then local okS, sArea = pcall(getRoomArea, srcRoom) local okD, dArea = pcall(getRoomArea, destRoom) if okS and okD and sArea ~= dArea and sArea > 0 and dArea > 0 then sameArea = false end end if sameArea then local ok, sx, sy, sz = pcall(getRoomCoordinates, srcRoom) if ok and sx then local o = igoto.OFFSET[p.dir] local nx, ny, nz = sx + o[1], sy + o[2], sz + o[3] pcall(setRoomCoordinates, destRoom, nx, ny, nz) -- Tell the Icesus mapper where we put it, so it anchors the NEXT rooms -- you discover to this cell (same z-plane) instead of the old one, and -- mark the cell taken so freeCoord won't drop another room on top of it. local m = idMap() if m then if m.placed then m.placed[destHex] = { nx, ny, nz } end if getRoomArea and m.areaCoords then local okA, aid = pcall(getRoomArea, destRoom) if okA and aid then m.areaCoords[aid] = m.areaCoords[aid] or {} m.areaCoords[aid][nx .. "," .. ny .. "," .. nz] = true end end end if getRoomArea and setRoomArea then local okA, aid = pcall(getRoomArea, srcRoom) if okA and aid and aid > 0 then pcall(setRoomArea, destRoom, aid) end end end end end if icesus and icesus.mapper and icesus.mapper.noteDirty then icesus.mapper.noteDirty() end
local placedNote = "" if p.dir then if p.dir == "up" or p.dir == "down" then placedNote = " (placed " .. p.dir .. ")" else placedNote = " (dotted line " .. p.dir .. ")" end end say("linked '%s': %s --> %s%s", p.phrase, (p.sname ~= "" and p.sname) or ("#" .. srcRoom), (getRoomName and getRoomName(destRoom)) or ("#" .. destRoom), placedNote)
say(" src %s", roomPos(srcRoom)) say(" dest %s", roomPos(destRoom)) -- Self-test: can the pathfinder now route across it? (one hop, source->dest) local ok = getPath and getPath(srcRoom, destRoom) if ok then say("pathfinder routes through it. Note it's ONE-WAY (%s only).", p.phrase) if p.dir then say("tip: go through, then run <cyan>goto relayout<reset> to tidy the rooms onto this level.") end else warn("pathfinder is NOT routing through it yet. Run <cyan>hlink check<reset> " .. "standing in the source room and send me the output.") end end
function igoto.linkDel(phrase) phrase = trim(phrase) if phrase == "" then warn("usage: hlink del <phrase>") return end local removed = 0 for srcHex, list in pairs(igoto.links) do for i = #list, 1, -1 do if list[i].cmd == phrase then local srcRoom = roomOfHex(srcHex) if srcRoom then if removeSpecialExit then pcall(removeSpecialExit, srcRoom, phrase) end local dir = list[i].dir if dir then if removeCustomLine then pcall(removeCustomLine, srcRoom, dir) end -- Only up/down use exit stubs; cardinals use dotted lines only. if setExitStub and (dir == "up" or dir == "down") then pcall(setExitStub, srcRoom, dir, false) end end end table.remove(list, i); removed = removed + 1 end end if #list == 0 then igoto.links[srcHex] = nil end end igoto.saveLinks() if removed > 0 then say("removed %d hidden link(s) named '%s'.", removed, phrase) else warn("no hidden link named '%s'.", phrase) end end
function igoto.linkList() local rows = {} for srcHex, list in pairs(igoto.links) do for _, lk in ipairs(list) do local live = roomOfHex(srcHex) and roomOfHex(lk.destHex) rows[#rows + 1] = string.format(" <cyan>%s<reset> %s -> %s%s\n", lk.cmd, (lk.sname ~= "" and lk.sname) or srcHex, (lk.dname ~= "" and lk.dname) or lk.destHex, live and "" or " <indian_red>(off map)<reset>") end end if #rows == 0 then say("no hidden links recorded yet.") return end cecho("<sea_green>goto:<reset> hidden exits:\n") table.sort(rows) for _, line in ipairs(rows) do cecho(line) end end
-- Diagnostic: what does the map actually hold for the current room, and can -- getPath route across each recorded link from here? function igoto.linkCheck() local cur, hex = igoto.currentRoom() cecho("<sea_green>goto check:<reset>\n") cecho(string.format(" here: %s hex=%s\n", cur and roomPos(cur) or "nil", tostring(hex))) if not cur then warn("this room isn't on the map -- take a step.") return end
if getSpecialExits then local ok, ex = pcall(getSpecialExits, cur) if ok and type(ex) == "table" then local shown = false for k, v in pairs(ex) do if type(v) == "table" then -- {roomid = {cmd = lock}} for cmd, lock in pairs(v) do shown = true cecho(string.format(" special exit: '%s' -> #%s (lock=%s)\n", tostring(cmd), tostring(k), tostring(lock))) end else -- flat {cmd = roomid} shown = true cecho(string.format(" special exit: '%s' -> #%s\n", tostring(k), tostring(v))) end end if not shown then cecho(" special exits on this room: (none)\n") end else cecho(" getSpecialExits returned nothing usable\n") end end
local list = hex and igoto.links[hex] if not list or #list == 0 then cecho(" recorded links from this room: (none)\n") else for _, lk in ipairs(list) do local d = roomOfHex(lk.destHex) local verdict if not d then verdict = "<indian_red>dest not on map<reset>" elseif getPath and getPath(cur, d) then verdict = "<green>PATH OK<reset>" else verdict = "<indian_red>NO PATH<reset>" end cecho(string.format(" link '%s' -> %s %s\n", lk.cmd, d and roomPos(d) or ("hex "..tostring(lk.destHex)), verdict)) end end end
-- Direction commands route through here: if the current room has a hidden exit -- mapped to that direction, send the phrase instead; otherwise pass the -- direction through unchanged. (send() bypasses aliases, so goto is unaffected.) function igoto.dirCmd(raw) raw = trim(raw) if igoto.reroute then local d = igoto.DIR[raw:lower()] local hex = d and curHex() local list = hex and igoto.links[hex] if list then for _, lk in ipairs(list) do if lk.dir == d then send(lk.cmd) return end end end end send(raw) end
-- hlink [<mapdir>] <phrase> | hlink list | hlink del <phrase> | hlink check function igoto.hlink(arg) arg = trim(arg) local first, rest = arg:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$") local low = (first or ""):lower() if low == "" or low == "list" then igoto.linkList() return end if low == "check" or low == "test" then igoto.linkCheck() return end if low == "del" or low == "rm" or low == "delete" then igoto.linkDel(rest) return end -- Optional leading map-direction (only when a phrase follows it). local canon = igoto.DIR[low] if canon and igoto.OFFSET[canon] and trim(rest) ~= "" then igoto.startLink(rest, canon) else igoto.startLink(arg, nil) end end
-- ---- settings persistence --------------------------------------------- local function settingsPath() return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/IcesusGoto.settings.lua" end
function igoto.saveSettings() if table and table.save then pcall(table.save, settingsPath(), { adjacent = igoto.adjacent, annotate = igoto.annotate, reroute = igoto.reroute }) end end
function igoto.loadSettings() local p = settingsPath() if io and io.exists and io.exists(p) and table and table.load then local t = {} local ok = pcall(table.load, p, t) if ok and type(t) == "table" then if t.adjacent ~= nil then igoto.adjacent = t.adjacent end if t.annotate ~= nil then igoto.annotate = t.annotate end if t.reroute ~= nil then igoto.reroute = t.reroute end end end end
-- ---- adjacency placement ----------------------------------------------- -- Newly discovered indoor rooms are dropped next to the room you came from, in -- the direction you moved, using that room's ACTUAL current coordinates (so it -- follows tiles you've dragged by hand). Only ever touches rooms new to the map -- (never rooms already visited before this session) and never outworld tiles, -- so it won't fight the mapper's fixed grid or a manual arrangement you've made. local SHORT = { north = "n", south = "s", east = "e", west = "w", northeast = "ne", northwest = "nw", southeast = "se", southwest = "sw", up = "u", down = "d", ["in"] = "in", out = "out", }
-- Remember the last movement direction the player sent, so a new room can be -- placed the way we actually moved (even through a one-way exit). function igoto.onSend(_, cmd) local d = igoto.DIR[trim(tostring(cmd or "")):lower()] igoto._lastSentDir = d -- nil for non-direction commands end
-- PLANE LOCK (only). On each move we fix ONLY the z of the room we arrived in, -- so a floor stays a floor -- e.g. everything past an `hlink down` stays one -- level below. We never touch x/y: room positioning is left entirely to the -- Mudlet mapper (auto x/y "adjacency" was removed by request -- it fought the -- mapper and stretched things). Toggle with `goto planelock on|off` -- (`goto adjacent` is kept as a synonym). function igoto.placeAdjacent() if not (igoto.adjacent and setRoomCoordinates and getRoomCoordinates) then return end local r = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if type(r) ~= "table" or type(r.id) ~= "string" or r.id == "" then return end if type(r.coords) == "table" and #r.coords >= 2 then return end -- outworld: authoritative local hex = r.id local room = roomOfHex(hex) if not room then return end local fromHex = igoto._prevHex if not fromHex or fromHex == hex then return end local fromRoom = roomOfHex(fromHex) if not fromRoom then return end
-- Which way did we move? (only its vertical component matters here) local moveDir = (igoto.walk and igoto.walk.active and igoto.walk.lastDir) or igoto._lastSentDir igoto._lastSentDir = nil if not (moveDir and igoto.OFFSET[moveDir]) then local backDir if type(r.exits) == "table" then for dir, dest in pairs(r.exits) do if dest == fromHex then backDir = igoto.DIR[dir] or dir break end end end moveDir = backDir and OPP[backDir] end if not (moveDir and igoto.OFFSET[moveDir]) then return end
-- Same area only; the from-room's z + this move's vertical step is the plane. if getRoomArea then local okF, fa = pcall(getRoomArea, fromRoom) local okT, ta = pcall(getRoomArea, room) if okF and okT and fa ~= ta then return end end local ok, _, _, fz = pcall(getRoomCoordinates, fromRoom) if not (ok and fz) then return end local wantZ = fz + igoto.OFFSET[moveDir][3]
local okR, cx, cy, cz = pcall(getRoomCoordinates, room) if not (okR and cx) or cz == wantZ then return end -- already on the right plane pcall(setRoomCoordinates, room, cx, cy, wantZ) -- keep x/y, fix only z local m = idMap() if m and m.placed then m.placed[hex] = { cx, cy, wantZ } end if icesus and icesus.mapper and icesus.mapper.noteDirty then icesus.mapper.noteDirty() end end
-- Tidy the CURRENT FLOOR: from the room you're in, walk cardinal exits only -- (never up/down/in/out, and never a special exit), staying on the same z and -- in the same area, and lay each room one cell from its parent in the connecting -- direction. Rooms on other floors are left untouched. Explicit command, so -- moving already-placed rooms on this floor is intended. function igoto.relayout() if not (getRoomExits and getRoomCoordinates and setRoomCoordinates) then warn("relayout: map API unavailable.") return end local startRoom = igoto.currentRoom() if not startRoom then warn("relayout: this room isn't mapped -- take a step.") return end local startArea if getRoomArea then local ok, a = pcall(getRoomArea, startRoom); if ok then startArea = a end end local m = idMap() if m and startArea and m.gridmoded and m.gridmoded[startArea] then warn("relayout: this is an outworld/grid area -- its coordinates are fixed. Skipped.") return end local okS, _, _, startZ = pcall(getRoomCoordinates, startRoom) if not (okS and startZ) then warn("relayout: can't read this room's position.") return end local roomToHex = {} if m and m.idToRoom then for h, rm in pairs(m.idToRoom) do roomToHex[rm] = h end end
local visited = { [startRoom] = true } local queue = { startRoom } local moved, LIMIT = 0, 250 while #queue > 0 and moved < LIMIT do local room = table.remove(queue, 1) local okC, px, py, pz = pcall(getRoomCoordinates, room) local ok, ex = pcall(getRoomExits, room) if okC and px and ok and type(ex) == "table" then for dir, dest in pairs(ex) do local long = igoto.DIR[dir] or dir local o = igoto.OFFSET[long] if o and o[3] == 0 and dest and not visited[dest] then -- cardinal only (same floor) local same = true if getRoomArea and startArea then local okA, a = pcall(getRoomArea, dest); if okA and a ~= startArea then same = false end end local onFloor = true -- leave other floors alone local okZ, _, _, dz = pcall(getRoomCoordinates, dest) if okZ and dz and dz ~= startZ then onFloor = false end if same and onFloor then visited[dest] = true local nx, ny, nz = px + o[1], py + o[2], pz + o[3] -- nz stays = startZ pcall(setRoomCoordinates, dest, nx, ny, nz) if m then local hx = roomToHex[dest] if hx and m.placed then m.placed[hx] = { nx, ny, nz } end if m.areaCoords and startArea then m.areaCoords[startArea] = m.areaCoords[startArea] or {} m.areaCoords[startArea][nx .. "," .. ny .. "," .. nz] = true end end moved = moved + 1 if moved >= LIMIT then break end queue[#queue + 1] = dest end end end end end if icesus and icesus.mapper and icesus.mapper.noteDirty then icesus.mapper.noteDirty() end if moved >= LIMIT then warn("relayout: moved %d rooms (hit the %d cap -- this floor likely connects widely).", moved, LIMIT) else say("relayout: tidied %d rooms on this floor.", moved) end end
-- ---- room-line annotation ---------------------------------------------- -- Append hidden exits into the game's own room-exits line, e.g. -- A barren clearing in the forest (ne and nw and down for 'enter crack') -- with the command word in the game's special-exit colour (bright green). local DIRWORDS = {} for long, short in pairs(SHORT) do DIRWORDS[long] = true; DIRWORDS[short] = true end
-- Is this parenthetical the current room's own exit line? (Its direction tokens -- must cover every cardinal exit the room reports — filters "Street lamp -- (glowing)" and mistimed lines.) local function isRoomExitLine(exits) local r = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if type(r) ~= "table" or type(r.exits) ~= "table" then return false end local toks = {} for w in exits:lower():gmatch("[a-z]+") do if DIRWORDS[w] then toks[w] = true end end if not next(toks) then return false end for dir in pairs(r.exits) do local long = igoto.DIR[dir] or dir if SHORT[long] then -- a real compass/vertical exit if not (toks[long] or toks[SHORT[long]]) then return false end end end return true end
function igoto.annotateLine() if not igoto.annotate then return end local hex = curHex() local list = hex and igoto.links[hex] if not (list and #list > 0) then return end local exits = matches and matches[3] if not exits or not isRoomExitLine(exits) then return end local parts = {} for _, lk in ipairs(list) do parts[#parts + 1] = (lk.dir and (lk.dir .. " for ") or "") .. "'" .. lk.cmd .. "'" end local add = " and " .. table.concat(parts, " and ") -- selectCaptureGroup(N) maps to matches[N]: 1=whole line, 2=room name, -- 3=exits. So the exits are group 3 (verified headless on Mudlet 4.22). if (selectCaptureGroup(3) or 0) > 0 then local er, eg, eb = getFgColor() replace(exits .. add) if (selectString(exits .. add, 1) or -1) > 0 then setFgColor(er or 0, eg or 128, eb or 128) end local c = igoto.LINK_CMD_COLOR for _, lk in ipairs(list) do if (selectString(lk.cmd, 1) or -1) > 0 then setFgColor(c[1], c[2], c[3]) end end end end
-- One-shot dump of what the walker sees in the current room -- use it if -- road-walk still won't trigger, and send me the output. function igoto.debug() local r = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info local id, hex = igoto.currentRoom() local env = (id and getRoomEnv) and getRoomEnv(id) or nil cecho("<sea_green>goto debug:<reset>\n") cecho(string.format(" hex=%s env=%s\n map: %s\n", tostring(hex), tostring(env), id and roomPos(id) or "not on map")) cecho(string.format(" prevHex=%s adjacent=%s annotate=%s\n", tostring(igoto._prevHex), tostring(igoto.adjacent), tostring(igoto.annotate))) if r then cecho(string.format(" name='%s'\n area='%s' terrain='%s'\n", tostring(r.name), tostring(r.area), tostring(r.terrain))) cecho(string.format(" coords=%s x=%s y=%s\n", type(r.coords) == "table" and ("{" .. table.concat(r.coords, ",") .. "}") or tostring(r.coords), tostring(r.x), tostring(r.y))) else cecho(" gmcp.Room.Info is nil\n") end cecho(string.format(" onRoad=%s inOutworld=%s\n", tostring(onRoad()), tostring(inOutworld()))) if id and getRoomExits then local ok, ex = pcall(getRoomExits, id) if ok and type(ex) == "table" then for dir, dest in pairs(ex) do cecho(string.format(" exit %-9s -> %s\n", dir, roomPos(dest))) end end end end
-- ---- command dispatch -------------------------------------------------- function igoto.help() cecho([[<sea_green>Icesus Goto<reset> -- travel + room nicknames <cyan>goto <dest><reset> walk to a nickname, room number, or room name <cyan>goto stop<reset> stop walking now <cyan>goto reweigh<reset> weight the whole map from terrain (run once after install) <cyan>goto planelock on|off<reset> keep rooms on the right floor (z), leave x/y to the mapper <cyan>goto annotate on|off<reset> show hidden exits inside the room's exit line <cyan>goto reroute on|off<reset> typing a hidden exit's map-dir sends its phrase <cyan>goto relayout<reset> tidy the CURRENT FLOOR around you (lay rooms out adjacent) <cyan>goto trace<reset> toggle per-step decisions (road-walk vs step) on/off <cyan>goto debug<reset> print what the walker sees in this room <cyan>goto help<reset> this help <cyan>rnick <name><reset> save the room you're in as <name> <cyan>rnick list<reset> list saved nicknames <cyan>rnick del <name><reset> forget a nickname <cyan>hlink <phrase><reset> record a hidden exit: sends <phrase>, links this room to the one you land in (goto can then use it) <cyan>hlink <dir> <phrase><reset> same, and place the far room to <dir> on the map <cyan>hlink list<reset> / <cyan>hlink del <phrase><reset> <cyan>goto danger<reset> flag current room as dangerous (goto avoids it; uses it only as last resort) <cyan>goto safe<reset> remove the flag from the current room <cyan>goto danger list<reset> list all flagged rooms short forms: <cyan>gt<reset> = goto, <cyan>rn<reset> = rnick, <cyan>hl<reset> = hlink, <cyan>rd<reset> = room danger ]]) end
function igoto.cmd(arg) arg = trim(arg) local lower = arg:lower() if arg == "" or lower == "help" then igoto.help() return end if lower == "stop" then igoto.stop() return end if lower == "reweigh" or lower == "reweight" then igoto.reweighAll() return end if lower == "relayout" or lower == "tidy" then igoto.relayout() return end local key, rest = arg:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$") key = key and key:lower() if key == "adjacent" or key == "planelock" or key == "annotate" or key == "reroute" then local skey = (key == "planelock") and "adjacent" or key -- planelock stored as `adjacent` local val = (rest or ""):lower() if val == "on" or val == "off" then igoto[skey] = (val == "on") else igoto[skey] = not igoto[skey] end igoto.saveSettings() say("%s: %s", key, igoto[skey] and "ON" or "OFF") return end if lower == "danger" or lower == "mark danger" then igoto.dangerMark() return end if lower == "safe" or lower == "unmark" or lower == "undanger" then igoto.dangerUnmark() return end if lower == "danger list" or lower == "danger ls" then igoto.dangerList() return end if lower == "debug" then igoto.debug() return end if lower == "trace" then igoto.trace = not igoto.trace say("per-step trace %s.", igoto.trace and "ON" or "OFF") return end local id, err, label, handled = igoto.resolve(arg) if not id then if not handled and err then warn("%s.", err) end return end igoto.start(id, label) end
function igoto.nick(arg) arg = trim(arg) local sub, rest = arg:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$") sub = (sub or ""):lower() if sub == "" or sub == "list" then igoto.nickList() return end if sub == "del" or sub == "rm" or sub == "delete" then igoto.nickDel(rest) return end if sub == "go" or sub == "goto" then igoto.cmd(rest) return end igoto.nickAdd(arg) -- whole arg is the nickname end
-- rd [del|list] — shorthand for "goto danger/safe/list" function igoto.rd(arg) arg = trim(arg or ""):lower() if arg == "" or arg == "mark" then igoto.dangerMark() elseif arg == "del" or arg == "rm" or arg == "unmark" or arg == "clear" or arg == "safe" then igoto.dangerUnmark() elseif arg == "list" or arg == "ls" then igoto.dangerList() else warn("usage: rd [del|list] (mark/unmark current room as dangerous)") end end
-- ---- boot -------------------------------------------------------------- -- Runs on install and on every profile load. Re-register cleanly so a -- reload never stacks duplicate handlers. if igoto._roomHandler and killAnonymousEventHandler then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, igoto._roomHandler) end if registerAnonymousEventHandler then igoto._roomHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Room.Info", "igoto.onRoomEvent") if igoto._sendHandler then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, igoto._sendHandler) end igoto._sendHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDataSendRequest", "igoto.onSend") end
-- Movement triggers: read Icesus's own lines so a road-walk advances the -- instant it ends, rather than waiting on a timer. They no-op unless a goto -- road-walk is in progress. Re-created cleanly on every reload. local function regTrig(slot, regex, fn) if igoto[slot] and killTrigger then pcall(killTrigger, igoto[slot]) end igoto[slot] = nil if tempRegexTrigger then local ok, id = pcall(tempRegexTrigger, regex, fn) if ok then igoto[slot] = id end end end regTrig("_trigStop", [[^You stop walking ]], function() igoto.onStopWalk() end) regTrig("_trigRefuse", [[^As there is different terrain to .+ you stand still]], function() igoto.onRefused() end) regTrig("_trigRoomLine", [[^(.+) \(([^()]+)\)\s*$]], function() igoto.annotateLine() end)
igoto.loadSettings() igoto.loadNicks() igoto.loadLinks() igoto.applyLinks() -- best-effort; per-visit reapply covers the rest igoto.loadDanger() igoto.applyDanger() -- stamp high weights onto danger rooms after map loads
